summary: Scientists may have solved the mystery of why Antarctica froze millions of years before the Arctic. Once glaciers took hold, their bright surfaces reflected sunlight and helped cool the region further.

title: Atomic catalyst unlocks the hidden value of plant waste

title: Scientists find hidden “highways” guiding animal evolution

title: Common medications may change your gut for years
summary: Common medications may reshape the gut microbiome long after the last dose is taken. Some effects were still detectable years later, suggesting past medication use may strongly influence the gut bacteria people carry today.

title: Too much or too little sleep may make your body age faster

Short or long sleep was also associated with numerous conditions affecting the brain, heart, lungs, metabolism, and digestive system.
